drafted_from: tool:read-my-api-descriptions's own row (its words, input schema and sample run) in tools/describe-the-workshop/what-this-tool-does-and-how-to-run-it.json; its sample run did not end well in the landing check, so this kit is a draft until a real run's answer is put in
start_here: Say to your AI: "Read the tools my connected API descriptions offer right now", with {"wait": false}. It runs tool:read-my-api-descriptions and answers each connected source with the tools it offers.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it reads your connected sources and answers, and keeps no row.
instructions: 1. Connect at least one API description (OpenAPI) to your account first; with none connected the answer is empty.
2. Say "Read my tool sources". The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-my-api-descriptions and {"wait": false}.

3. Read the answer's reads: one entry per source with the tools it offers now; give need the id of one tool to read only that one, or run tool:derive-current-api-description-rows to turn one source's tools into rows.

worked_examples.title: Read every connected source once
worked_examples.ask: What tools do my connected sources offer right now?
worked_examples.given: The input {"wait": false} for an account with one connected API description.
worked_examples.hands_back: An object whose reads holds one entry for that source, listing the tools it offers (draft: the values of a real run are not yet put in).
